article-meta.related-article: This corrects the article "Transfer learning promotes acquisition of individual BCI skills", pgae076.

body.p: This is a correction to: Satyam Kumar et al., Transfer learning promotes acquisition of individual BCI skills, PNAS Nexus, Volume 3, Issue 2, February 2024, pgae076, https://doi.org/10.1093/pnasnexus/pgae076
In the section ‘GR transfer learning with common spatial patterns’, the text:

we observe that CSP-Expert-Subject (0.3727 ± 0.2924, N = 144) significantly outperforms both the CSP-Subject-Specific-Fix (0.3727 ± 0.2924, N = 144, 1.05 × 10−10). and CSP-Subject-Specific-Adapt (0.3727 ± 0.2924, N = 144, P = 7.22 × 10−5) decoders.

we observe that CSP-Expert-Subject (0.3727 ± 0.2924, N = 144) significantly outperforms both the CSP-Subject- Specific-Fix (0.2120 ± 0.2815, N = 144, 1.05e − 10) and CSP-Subject-Specific-Adapt (0.2515 ± 0.3082, N = 144, p = 7.22e − 5) decoders.
